senses.def: Maintenance service provided after the sale of a product
Assist-2-Sell, a real-estate franchise organisation in the United States of America
Amazon Associates Web Service
a United States territory on the eastern part of the island of Samoa

a very poisonous metallic element that has three allotropic forms; arsenic and arsenic compounds are used as herbicides and insecticides and in various alloys; found in arsenopyrite and orpiment and realgar
to the same degree (often followed by ‘as’)
ex: they were equally beautiful
birds were singing and the child sang as sweetly

senses.def: To such an extent or degree; to the same extent or degree.
ex: She regards her kids as (being) holy as saints.
You’re not as tall as I am, but you are definitely as happy as can be.

senses.def: Considered to be, in relation to something else; in the relation (specified).
For example; for instance. (Compare such as.)
In the (same) way or manner that; to the (same) degree that.
ex: Do as I say!
I'm under a lot of pressure, as you know.

senses.def: Used after so or as to introduce a comparison.
ex: She's twice as strong as I was two years ago.
It's not so complicated as I expected.

senses.def: Used to introduce a result: with the result that it is; as to.
Expressing concession: though.
ex: (As) much as I respect your viewpoint, I can’t agree.
(As) bravely as they fought, they soon lost the battle.

senses.def: At the same instant or moment that: when.
ex: As I came in, she fled.

senses.def: At the same time that, during the same time when: while.
ex: He sleeps as the rain falls.

senses.def: Varying through time in the same proportion that.
ex: As my fear grew, so did my legs become heavy.
As she grew older, she grew wiser.

senses.def: Being that, considering that, because, since.
ex: As it’s too late, I quit.
(As) tired as he was, I decided not to disturb him.

senses.def: Introducing a comparison with a hypothetical state (+ subjunctive, or with the verb elided): as though, as if.
used before a preposition to clarify that the prepositional phrase restricts the meaning of the sentence; specifically.
ex: The case is dismissed as between Jones and Smith.
The case is dismissed as against Smith.

senses.def: Functioning as a relative conjunction, and sometimes like a relative pronoun: that, which, who. (See usage notes.)
ex: You strike me as being a very fidgety type of person.
He had the same problem as she did getting the lock open.

senses.def: Introducing a basis of comparison, with an object in the objective case.
ex: You are not as tall as my sister.
They are big as houses.

senses.def: In the role of.
ex: What is your opinion as a parent?
As your big sis, I worry about your life too.

senses.def: In the form of.
ex: I bought you a new toy as a special treat.

senses.def: A libra, a Roman pound.
Any of several coins of Rome, coined in bronze or later copper; or the equivalent value.
Used to intensify an adjective; very much; extremely.
ex: sweet as
